description: Defines ASN.1 related structures and classes for RRC NR UL-DCCH messages in 5G NR protocol, including choice types and message sequence structures.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message types in UL-DCCH message, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the full UL-DCCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type enum value.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.
